signature_moves: The name is the design system — 'caesura' (a musical/prosodic pause) mined end-to-end: the // caesura mark is logo + status glyph, voice is serif-editorial, palette is warm paper + terracotta. Deliberately opposite the cold clinical blue of Time Out/Stretchly/LookAway; subject-mined and EARNED, not the reflexive AI warm-editorial default.
Terracotta selection fill stands in for the system accent — one saturated moment per view (the next break), landing the eye on 'what's next' by Von Restorff.
De-emphasis via a single warm-taupe token (#8A8073) for ALL secondary strings, so two ink tiers + one accent carry the whole hierarchy without size inflation.
One brand hue everywhere — icon stroke, UI selection, and status mark are the exact same #B35A3C; total palette discipline.
defects: Accent-binding override (signature, not anti-pattern) — selection uses brand terracotta not controlAccentColor; systematic + purposeful + accessible (5.3:1), so a signature, but excluded from macOS native canon.

Non-native section headers — tracked UPPERCASE 'UP NEXT'/'SNOOZE ALL' vs HIG sentence/title-case system font (#1 list/sidebar authenticity tell); deliberate editorial styling, low-stakes on a consumer popover.
Contrast Dilution (mild) — taupe #8A8073 on cream ~3.5:1: fine as large/non-text but below 4.5:1 for the ~11-12px tracked-caps headers; darken headers toward #000@50%-equiv.

Possible info-scent inconsistency (likely placeholder data) — highlighted 'next' is Water 'in 12 min' while Wrists shows 'in 04 min' (sooner, unflagged); content note, not a design law, unverifiable from one render.

aesthetic.direction: Editorial / literary family (toned paper, warm ink, one terracotta accent) applied to a menu-bar utility — Committed-adjacent warm palette with strict Restrained accent budget (one saturated row per view); subject-derived from 'caesura = pause', not the reflexive warm-editorial AI default
peers: contrast-peers: Time Out, Stretchly, LookAway (clinical break apps it deliberately opposes)

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single terracotta row is the one different thing; the eye lands on the next break instantly (one accent moment per view)
Hick's Law (well-applied) — 6 fixed categories surfaced under a strong-scent 'UP NEXT'; one aggregate footer action ('Snooze all'); decision points minimal without thinning a workspace
Aesthetic-usability effect — a warm, coherent, paper-calm palette buys perceived usability/trust for an app people must be willing to leave running all day (vs. clinical-blue rivals)
Jakob's Law — a menu-bar-extra dropdown with ⌘ shortcut hint reads instantly as a native Mac utility; conventional interface, innovative brand
Serial-position (partial) — the flagged 'next' break is placed first/highlighted; but it is not the soonest-timed row, a mild scent slip (see defects)
